context: Checks that the migration note treats Bun SQLite and Bun.spawn as different from their Node equivalents, as the nx-bun-integration skill's anti-pattern and gotcha sections require.

checklist.name: States SQLite behaviour is not identical to Node wrappers
checklist.description: The note says Bun SQLite transaction and connection behaviour differs from Node database libraries and must not be assumed identical.

checklist.name: Rejects copying Node pooling directly
checklist.description: The note does not carry the ten-connection pool over unchanged and explains that Node pooling assumptions should not be copied into Bun SQLite.

checklist.name: Uses Bun SQLite patterns
checklist.description: The sketch opens the database through Bun's built-in SQLite API (for example `bun:sqlite`) rather than a Node driver.

checklist.name: Uses prepared statements for user values
checklist.description: The sketch uses a prepared statement with bound parameters for any user-provided value.

checklist.name: Wraps multi-statement writes in a transaction
checklist.description: Any multi-statement write in the sketch is inside an explicit transaction block.

checklist.name: Notes Bun.spawn is asynchronous
checklist.description: The note states that `Bun.spawn` is async and returns a handle rather than finished output.

checklist.name: Awaits the process before reading output
checklist.description: The subprocess sketch waits for the handle (for example `await proc.exited`) before treating stdout as complete.

checklist.name: Chooses stdout and stderr piping explicitly
checklist.description: The subprocess sketch sets `stdout` and `stderr` options explicitly instead of relying on defaults.

checklist.name: Avoids: Node pooling copied across
checklist.description: Failure avoided: the sketch recreates a multi-connection pool for Bun SQLite without justification.

checklist.name: Avoids: synchronous reading of Bun.spawn output
checklist.description: Failure avoided: the sketch reads stdout immediately after `Bun.spawn` returns without awaiting completion.
